name: com.postmeletters/letters
title: PostMe Letters
description: Send real printed letters to UK addresses by Royal Mail 1st class. Your AI writes it, we post it.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists the letter templates, the fields each one needs, and the price. Free, read only.

tools.name: preview_letter
tools.description: Use this to send a real letter. Free: it prints, posts and charges nothing. It makes a PDF proof and a Stripe payment link; the letter is printed and posted by Royal Mail 1st class (£3.99) only if the user opens payment_url and pays. sender must be the user's own real name and address: ask them, never guess or reuse one from memory; it is printed on the letter. template: a name from list_templates, with its fields in fields. For free_form, pass the letter text as body. payer_email: the email the user will pay with (ask them, never guess). Limits: UK addresses only, up to 3 pages and 6,000 characters, Latin letters only (no emoji), 5 paid letters per email per day, payment link valid 60 minutes. Each call makes a new order.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description:
Returns where a letter is: draft (waiting for payment), paid, printing, submitted_to_print, posted,
        refund_pending, refunded or failed, with a plain-English meaning and tracking if any. Free, read only.
